John Deere develops technology and equipment solutions to address global food, fiber, and infrastructure challenges. The Software Developer will join an agile product team to develop, test, maintain, and support software applications and services that improve manufacturing operations and business processes.

Responsibilities
Develop, test, debug, and maintain software applications and services
Participate in agile team activities such as planning, estimation, backlog refinement, and retrospectives
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established engineering standards and best practices
Participate in code reviews and use feedback to continuously improve your technical skills
Investigate and resolve software defects and production issues with guidance from experienced team members
Learn and apply modern software engineering practices, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and observability
Collaborate with teammates and business partners to understand requirements and deliver effective technical solutions
Contribute to application documentation, technical knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement efforts
Build knowledge of manufacturing processes, business operations, and the technologies that support them

* Foundational programming and problem-solving skills
* Basic understanding of web application development, APIs, databases, and software testing concepts
* Familiarity with Git and modern software development practices
* Strong communication, collaboration, and learning agility
Ideally you will have a degree or equivalent related work experience in the following:
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field; or equivalent relevant experience
Must be 18 years of age or older to apply
Preferred
* Exposure to Python, SQL, or data engineering concepts through coursework, internships, personal projects, or professional experience
* Familiarity with cloud-native development practices and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud platforms
* Experience using GitHub and modern software development workflows, including pull requests and automated testing
* Exposure to Agile software development methodologies and team-based delivery practices
* Familiarity with application monitoring, observability, or troubleshooting concepts
* Experience with data platforms such as Databricks or analytics-focused solutions
* Knowledge of manufacturing, supply chain, or industrial business processes
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot
